author: ttravis786
body:
Adds the input files for the HGCal neural-network common-mode (CM) correction, required for https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/52377.

New files in `CMCalibrations/`:

- `cm_dnn_multimodule_zscore.pth`: TorchScript model, with z-score normalised inputs and outputs
- `cm_dnn_multimodule_zscore_manifest.json`: input feature order and module vocabulary of the model
- `cm_dnn_multimodule_zscore_preprocessing.json`: z-score normalisation parameters of the model
- `cellareas.json`: cell-area fractions used as an NN input
- `README.md`: description of the files

Details on the model: https://indico.cern.ch/event/1718533/#sc-8-8-noise-mitigation

No existing files are changed. The CMSSW PR https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/52377 explains the correction in full and describes the validation.
title: HGCAL: Introducing necessary config files for a HGCAL NN based CM corrections
